summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Kranti Ganesh Mandal 2026. Backend: 40/40 pytest cases pass (auth, register+pending block, RBAC on members/payments/expenses/events, admin management, member approval flow, Vargani financial math with overpay validation, expenses, events, dashboard aggregates, vargani/expenses/events reports, CSV export, notifications). Frontend: Super admin login succeeds, dashboard renders correct KPIs (₹25,000 target · ₹19,000 collected · ₹6,000 pending · ₹14,000 net balance · ₹5,000 expenses), Quick Actions visible for admin, Members tab shows Approve/Reject controls for pending members, More tab exposes Admin Management/Audit Logs. Minor web-only console warnings observed (font TTFs failing to decode via Expo asset resolver, deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents style props, useNativeDriver fallback) — do not block functionality but degrade typography on web preview.

issues: Custom fonts (PlusJakartaSans, SpaceGrotesk) fail to decode via /assets?unstable_path... URL → 'OTS parsing error: invalid sfntVersion'. Falls back to system font on web; native builds unaffected.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated on RN Web — use boxShadow. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card definition)
props.pointerEvents is deprecated; move to style.pointerEvents. Likely from BlurView/LinearGradient wrappers in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx
useNativeDriver fallback warning on web (harmless on web preview but noisy). Consider Platform.OS==='web' ? false : true where Animated is used.

action_items: (Optional/UX) Investigate custom font 404/decode failures on web preview — Metro asset resolver returns HTML for .ttf URLs. App is fully usable with fallback system fonts.
(Optional) Migrate StyleSheet shadow* props to boxShadow and Animated pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1050 lines — consider splitting into routers per module (auth/members/vargani/expenses/events/reports) for maintainability, but not blocking.
Overpay validation correctly enforced (400 when amount > pending and allow_overpay false).
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via projection everywhere; uuid `id` field used consistently.
JWT with token_version rotation on logout/password-change/deactivation implemented correctly.
RBAC via require_roles dependency is applied consistently on all write and privileged read endpoints.
